_note: Synthetic. Demonstrates FR12/FR12a/FR13/FR13a/DR4 — the regional-spreadsheets data source formalized into a structured, versioned, provenance-tracked knowledge base, with a feedback loop from analyst overrides. 'Seed' entries model curated migration from today's shadow spreadsheets (illustrative content, not real Northgate exceptions). The 'candidate' entry models the feedback loop firing off INV-1005's resolution — this is the trust-building mechanism, not the seed data.

schema.status: approved | pending_review — an entry with status other than approved shall not influence auto-processed (high-confidence) determinations, per FR12a
schema.jurisdiction: which jurisdiction this exception applies to
schema.rule: the exception itself, in plain language

provenance.added_by: role, not an invented named individual
provenance.reviewed_by: role that approved it, or null if still pending
provenance.review_date: ISO date, or null if still pending

schema.origin_transaction: the invoice_id that triggered this entry, if it came from the feedback loop rather than initial curation — null for seed entries
